summary: Frontend E2E test of (1) Sync Hub Review Mode overlay and (2) Sync Failure Alarm banner on admin dashboard. Review Mode overlay opens correctly, renders 475 cards, Add/Ignore/Clearance toggle all work as spec'd and progress counter updates (473 left / 1 added / 1 ignored). Two functional bugs found: (A) 'Done' close button does NOT close the overlay because the admin sidebar renders ABOVE the full-screen overlay (z-index bug) - Done button visually and functionally intercepted by sidebar. (B) Sync Failure Alarm banner NEVER appears on the dashboard: POST /api/sync-alerts/test returns recorded:true & email_configured:true, but an immediate GET /api/sync-alerts/status still returns {failures:[], stuck:[], has_alerts:false}. The test alert is not being surfaced via the status endpoint, so the frontend SyncFailureAlert component correctly hides itself. Regression: normal Sync Hub list view and dashboard still render fine.

critical.issue: Right after POST /api/sync-alerts/test returns recorded:true, GET /api/sync-alerts/status returns failures:[], has_alerts:false. The test alert is not persisted/queryable, so the dashboard SyncFailureAlert banner never renders. Contradicts the pre-verification note in the review request.

ui_bugs.issue: 'Done' close button click is intercepted because the admin sidebar (right rail) is stacked ABOVE the overlay. Sidebar is visible on the right in Review Mode. Force-clicks on data-testid='review-mode-close-btn' at x=1666 land on the sidebar layer, so onClose never fires and the overlay never closes. Fix: raise SyncReviewMode container z-index above sidebar (e.g. z-[100] on the fixed overlay) OR render it as a portal on document.body.

integration_issues.issue: Banner never renders because /api/sync-alerts/status returns has_alerts:false immediately after a successful test alert POST. Frontend SyncFailureAlert.jsx is correct - the backend status endpoint is the blocker.

issues: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop.' emitted by AdminDashboard render - needs a key on one of its list renders.

action_items: Fix Review Mode overlay z-index / render as portal so the Done (and Finish) button is clickable - currently blocked by admin sidebar.

Fix /api/sync-alerts/status so that the test alert recorded by POST /api/sync-alerts/test appears in the failures[] list with has_alerts:true. Possibly the alert is stored but the query filter (time window, dismissed flag default, supplier match) excludes it.
Add key prop to the list rendered inside AdminDashboard to silence the React warning.
critical_code_review_comments: SyncReviewMode.jsx: root container must use a higher z-index than the fixed admin sidebar (or use React portal). Currently full-screen overlay is not truly on top.
sync_alerts route: POST /test and GET /status appear out of sync - write and read paths must use the same collection/filter (dismissed=false, within recent window).
SyncHub.js is >3200 lines - recommend splitting into smaller focused files.

success_rate.frontend: 60% (Review Mode Add/Ignore/Clearance + regression pass; overlay-close and alarm banner fail)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two blockers for main agent: (1) Review Mode overlay z-index bug - sidebar renders on top of the fixed overlay so the Done button is not clickable. (2) sync-alerts status endpoint returns empty even right after test POST records a fresh alert. When retesting the alarm banner, first curl the status endpoint after POST /test to confirm has_alerts:true before checking UI. SKUs already mutated: GS-D8322 (added), GMB-R1200 (ignored). Remaining new-products count ~473 on Ceramica Impex.

rca_of_the_issue.review_mode_close: Admin layout sidebar has stacking context / z-index >= overlay's. SyncReviewMode root uses fixed inset-0 but its z-index is lower than or equal to the AdminSidebar. Even with playwright force=True, the click coordinate lands on the sidebar element which sits above the button, so the onClose handler never fires. Fix: bump z-index (e.g. z-[100] or higher than sidebar) or render via createPortal(document.body).
rca_of_the_issue.sync_alarm_banner: Backend POST /api/sync-alerts/test responds recorded:true, but GET /api/sync-alerts/status called seconds later returns failures:[] and has_alerts:false. The frontend SyncFailureAlert only renders when has_alerts is true, so the banner never mounts. Root cause is server-side: either the test route writes to a different collection/document than the status route reads, or the status filter (e.g. supplier not-null, timestamp window, dismissed flag) excludes the test record. Reproduction: curl -X POST $URL/api/sync-alerts/test then immediately curl $URL/api/sync-alerts/status - has_alerts stays false.
